_about: Hand-checked against gymreklab/TRTools (now gymrek-lab/TRTools) at ce22d847ea954e4f015818dc288dfa87a47761a8 (tag v6.1.0) on 2026-09-29, from README.rst, doc/index.rst, doc/UTILITIES.rst, doc/VIGNETTE-FILTER-QC.rst, trtools/dumpSTR/README.rst, trtools/mergeSTR/README.rst, trtools/statSTR/README.rst, pyproject.toml, dev-env.yml (rendered at https://trtools.readthedocs.io, the only documentation the README links), the v6.1.0 GitHub release, api.anaconda.org, PyPI and quay.io.

install.documented: conda install -c conda-forge -c bioconda trtools; or pip install --upgrade pip && pip install trtools (htslib and optionally bcftools installed separately); or docker pull quay.io/biocontainers/trtools:latest. A dev install from source (conda env create -f dev-env.yml, then poetry install) is only for editing the code.

extra_inputs.what: TR genotype VCF produced by a supported genotyper (AdVNTR, ExpansionHunter, GangSTR >=2.4, HipSTR, PopSTR >=2, LongTR); mergeSTR and region queries need it bgzipped, sorted and tabix-indexed.

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: TRTools only reads tandem-repeat genotype VCFs written by other callers; STRhub holds no VCF dataset, only reads (FASTQ/BAM) and the hg38 FASTA.

notes: TRTools has no genotyping step: it is nine separate executables (dumpSTR, mergeSTR, statSTR, compareSTR, qcSTR, associaTR, prancSTR, simTR, annotaTR; pyproject.toml:59-67) that filter, merge, QC, compare, associate and annotate VCFs 'downstream of genotyping' (README.rst:15), so program and command are null and source is none. If a representative invocation is wanted, the first command-line tool in the docs is dumpSTR: `dumpSTR --vcf <vcf file> --out <string> [filter options]` (trtools/dumpSTR/README.rst:16-19), with worked examples on the repo's example-files VCFs, e.g. `dumpSTR --vcf trio_chr21_popstr.sorted.vcf.gz --popstr-require-support 2 --popstr-min-call-DP 10 --out popstr-filtered --min-locus-callrate 1` (doc/VIGNETTE-FILTER-QC.rst:10-11). simTR simulates reads (needs ART's art_illumina) and does not genotype either. Platforms are empty on purpose: the input is a VCF, whatever platform the upstream caller used. README.rst has no install or usage text; both live in doc/index.rst (the readthedocs landing page) and trtools/*/README.rst (pulled in by doc/source/*.rst). The documented `docker pull quay.io/biocontainers/trtools:latest` fails as written: BioContainers publishes no 'latest' tag (manifest 404 on 2026-09-29); the image matching the pin is quay.io/biocontainers/trtools:6.1.0--pyhdfd78af_1, which the docs point to indirectly ('refer to the biocontainers registry for TRTools for all of our images', doc/index.rst:92). PyPI also holds trtools 6.1.0, and pyproject.toml declares a poetry-core build backend (pyproject.toml:1-3), so the pinned tree is pip-installable in principle (not tried here). The dev install (dev-env.yml + poetry) is for developers only (doc/index.rst:65,84-87) and dev-env.yml alone installs no TRTools, so conda is not acceptable. No release binaries exist.
